_doc: LANCE-19 batch 1: Partisan heavy tank (RGriffin65). Wheel half-discs and belts read off a side view of the level fit, inner faces only (x < 3200).
notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19, 2026-10-30), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. The fit is level and raised 165 mm so the belts rest on the ground (`no_icp` in partisan_veh.json; the v1 ICP pitched the kit). The kit's fused hull was split by `tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py` (partisan_prep.json) into the hull, the turret (`Partisan Turret`, turns about the vertical axis; its pivot moved to the centre of the kit's turret ring), the four barrels (`gun`, a node the original model lacks: the weapon nodes were re-parented under it; the barrels elevate about the turret's trunnion line) and two track belts (`track_l`, `track_r`: the faces within 110 mm of the closed belt path round the wheels). The seven wheels a side (`wheel_l0`..`wheel_r6`) are OWN GEOMETRY (`make_wheel`: tyre drum, recessed rim, hub boss, bolts) on axles fitted to the kit's half discs, which were cut from the hull. This own geometry is part of the CC BY-SA 4.0 derivative. 3,404 needle triangles left by the kit's simplification were dropped. Welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 8 degrees, no collapse; belts on a tread strip of two link pitches (0.485 m) by `veh_lowpoly.py`.
